 Indonesian President Prabowo Says Sorry To Singapore & Malaysia Over Prolonged Haze
 Aira Jailani
 17/11/2026 | 11:06 MYT 
 ${ stripe.text }
 ${ stripe.text }
 AI Brief
 Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has apologised to Malaysia and Singapore over the transboundary haze caused by forest and land fires in Indonesia.
 The Indonesian government has revoked the concessions of 17 companies, placed 104 others under investigation, and taken legal action against several companies linked to the fires.
 Prabowo acknowledged that improvements are needed in addressing the issue and said a new agency will be established to strengthen forest and land fire prevention efforts in the future.
 Advertisement 
 After months of dealing with transboundary haze caused by forest and land fires in Indonesia , Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has finally apologised to neighbouring countries Singapore and Malaysia over the issue.
 According to reports , Prabowo made the apology during a plenary session at the 49th ASEAN Summit in Manila, the Philippines, on 15 November.
 Advertisement 
 17 company concessions revoked 
 Image Credit: Astro Awani
 In a statement issued by the Indonesian Presidential Secretariat's Press, Media and Information Bureau, Prabowo assured that his administration is taking various measures to address the forest and land fires.
 According to him, the government ha s revoked 17 company concessions over the issue . Another 26 companies are under investigation, while 11 have been charged.
 Advertisement 
 In addition, 23 companies are scheduled to face charges, while 104 others are currently being investigated by the police.
 “The Indonesian government has a zero-tolerance policy towards companies involved in forest and land fires and has taken enforcement action, including the revocation of concessions and legal proceedings.”
 Image Credit: NST
 Indonesia has deployed 71,000 personnel for firefighting operations, with 16 of them losing their lives and many others suffering injuries .
 Acknowledges improvements are needed to tackle the issue 
 Prabowo also admitted that his administration needs to improve its handling of the transboundary haze issue .
 He said a new agency would be established to implement various programmes aimed at strengthening efforts to prevent forest and land fires in the future.
